text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since Winning
Ticket's realization about
how defeat truly
feels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But today she's training as if it were any
other day.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ack... This ship's running on fumes... Just
about break time I'd say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why would you use all your energy
warming up?! I expect you to train

seriously!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One thing, however, is different. She isn't
back to her usual,
enthusiastic self.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the by, I'm seeing a lot of people with
cameras around the course.
What's that
about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Reporters sniffing around for a story no
doubt. Today is a public
training day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now it makes sense! So the public's
here to train with us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's not what it means. Whenever a race
is approaching, journalists
come to see
how our training is coming along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And today is public day for the Derby. So
there are even more
reporters than usual it
seems.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, that was today?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
This is a good chance to see how the other
runners are faring. Let's go
check out
Hayahide and Taishin.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
This is a good chance to see how the other
runners are faring. Let's go
check out
Hayahide and Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, right... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Derby runners all gather to start
practicing in public view.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
There's the BNW trio. Narita Taishin won
the Satsuki Sho—all eyes'll
be on her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide isn't one to sneeze at
either. And she's only going to
get better
from here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as the reporters predicted, Narita
Taishin and Biwa Hayahide's
running sends
murmurs through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: All right, next is Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much they wait though,
Winning Ticket doesn't come
out. I start
feeling anxious that something might've
happened to her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, you seen Ticket?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No... I thought she headed for public
training with you two.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No... I thought she headed for public
training with you two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She didn't. And she wasn't near the
starting line when it was her turn
to run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, if you don't know...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No... She wouldn't!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taishin and Hayahide leave the scene in a
hurry. They must've
realized something
and gone to chase after Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a hope of catching up with
two Umamusume, but I go
looking for
them anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket! What're you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head in the direction of Narita Taishin's
voice and find her with Biwa
Hayahide and
Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is public training for the DERBY! And you're not running?! What're you hiding from?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I didn't mean to hide from anyone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But my legs... They just won't budge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You... don't mean you're injured, I take it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared... What if I can't keep up with
everyone in public training?
I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So that's what's been on your mind since
you lost the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: To hell with that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You lost your nerve after a single defeat?!
What happened to your
gotta-win
attitude?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've lost tons of times. And I was freaked
out when I saw I couldn't cut
it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But still... I faced my fears and worked my
butt off! 'Cause I wasn't
gonna break our
promise!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, forget it! This sucks!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're not the only one who's scared you
know. I continue on in spite
of my fear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more for us to say. It's up
to you to clear your head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The speechless racer watches on as her
friends depart.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I didn't realize it'd be this
scary...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You only get one shot at the Derby...
There's no next time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit in the trainers' office that night,
thinking about Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dream was born from seeing the Derby
up close as a kid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And chasing that dream, she entered the
academy full of hope and
trained day after
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always run toward her goal without
looking back, her desire to
win the Derby
stronger than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now that she's tasted defeat, she's
scared that her dream might
be crushed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm reflecting on this, I notice Ticket's
Derby notebook on the desk
and pick it
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right there under the photo stickers of the
three friends who are
chasing the Derby
together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a message. "I can do it! Only a
little more until I become a
Derby
champion!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words from when she held her dream
tight, before failure entered
her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want her to win. I want her to achieve her
dream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Helping her realize her potential is what a
trainer's supposed to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I won't fail her. I'll make sure the next
entry in her notebook says,
"Derby
champion Winning Ticket and her Derby
trainer!"
